newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Misfired artillary shell hits Taiwanese home.
newsitem.headline: Misfired artillary shell hits Taiwanese home.

text.p: Taiwan troops misfired an artillery shell into a house on Monday during routine practice in southern Taiwan but no one was injured, police said.
"It happened this morning but no one was hurt," a police officer told Reuters by telephone from Hengtsun where the incident occurred.
He declined to give further details.
The United Evening News said the shell was fired in an improper direction and crashed into the house of local resident, Yang Tien-sung.
The shell did not explode and was removed by the military, the newspaper said. Police and local media did not comment on the extent of damage to Yang's home.
